editions.headline: 多單 4 小時爆倉 4.04 億美元、盤中跌破 8 萬後收回，資金費率由 10% 降到 6.48%。
editions.headline_en: Longs lose $404M in four hours as BTC briefly breaks $80K and recovers; funding falls from 10% to 6.48%.

findings.title: 多單被洗出，選擇權轉為加價買下跌保護
Puell 衝上一年高點，主因是出塊加速而非過熱

editions.headline: ETF 10/22 暫定流出 6.36 億、抹掉前一天流入，淨實現獲利衝上 334 天新高。
editions.headline_en: ETFs −$636M on Oct 22 (provisional), erasing the prior day's inflow; net realized profit hits a 334-day high.

findings.title: 獲利了結擴散到全體持有者，84K 上方籌碼轉虧
ETF 三日流入一天抹掉，美國現貨買盤仍未回來

editions.headline: ETF 10/21 暫定流入 5.25 億，仍不敵那斯達克 −2.6%、布蘭特 113 美元的避險賣壓。
editions.headline_en: ETFs took a provisional $525M on Oct 21, yet a −2.6% Nasdaq and $113 Brent pulled Bitcoin back into risk-off selling.

findings.title: 短線買家趁跌集中獲利了結，不是恐慌砍倉
價格跌、資金費率卻翻正：槓桿多單回來，現貨偏弱

editions.headline: 空單清算 1.88 億、資金費率翻負 −4.48%，上漲靠軋空；ETF 近 7 個完整交易日轉為 +3.19 億。
editions.headline_en: Shorts lost $188M in liquidations and funding flipped to −4.48%: a short squeeze; ETF flows over the last 7 complete days turned +$319M.

editions.headline: IBIT 單日吸金 6.65 億，帶動 ETF 10/19 淨流入 5.27 億、近一個月最大；加權資金費率回落到 8.13%，這次換現貨走在槓桿前面。
editions.headline_en: IBIT took in $665M in a day, lifting ETF net inflows to $527M on 10/19 — the biggest in a month; weighted funding eased to 8.13%, so this time spot is running ahead of leverage.

editions.headline: 週一美股科技反彈、10 年期殖利率卻回到 5.14%，BTC 衝高回落收在區間低處；ETF 上週淨流出 2.28 億，加權資金費率升到 9.77%，槓桿仍跑在現貨前面。
editions.headline_en: Tech stocks bounced Monday but the 10-year yield climbed back to 5.14%, and BTC faded from its high to close near the bottom of its range; ETFs lost $228M last week while weighted funding rose to 9.77% — leverage is still running ahead of spot.

editions.headline: 荷莫茲海峽一週 10 艘船遇襲、創開戰以來新高，加權資金費率由 3.80% 回升到 9.20%，ETF 近 7 日仍 −8.56 億，週末槓桿先回、現貨買盤未回。
editions.headline_en: Hormuz sees 10 ships attacked in a week, the most since the war began; weighted funding rebounds from 3.80% to 9.20% while ETFs stay at −$856M over 7 days — leverage came back over the weekend, spot buyers did not.

editions.headline: 布蘭特油價收 109.86 美元、Strategy 因 MSCI 新規重挫約一成，BTC ETF 10/16 再流出 8,240 萬，加權資金費率由 9.81% 退回 3.80%，週末量縮觀望。
editions.headline_en: Brent settles at $109.86 and Strategy drops about 10% on MSCI's new rules; BTC ETFs bleed another $82.4M on 10/16 and weighted funding falls back from 9.81% to 3.80% as the weekend goes quiet.

editions.headline: 那斯達克重挫 2.1%、布蘭特油價盤中觸及 110 美元，BTC ETF 10/15 暫定只流入 510 萬、近 7 日仍流出 7.42 億，加權資金費率卻回升到 9.81%，槓桿比現貨資金先回來。
editions.headline_en: Nasdaq slumps 2.1% and Brent touches $110 intraday; BTC ETFs took in just $5.1M on 10/15 (prelim.), still −$742M over 7 days, yet weighted funding climbed back to 9.81% — leverage is returning before spot money.

editions.headline: PPI 月增 1.3% 創 2022 年來最大，全市場 24 小時清算 9.51 億美元、九成是多單；殖利率反而回落到 5.08%，ETF 10/14 暫定流出 2.61 億，槓桿洗掉後資金仍偏弱。
editions.headline_en: PPI jumps 1.3% m/m, the most since 2022, and $951M is liquidated in 24h, 90% of it longs; yields still fall to 5.08%, ETFs see a preliminary $261M outflow on 10/14, and flows stay weak after the leverage flush.

editions.headline: CPI 偏熱讓 10 月升息機率一度升到約 4 成、24 小時清算 3.31 億美元以多單為主；ETF 10/13 暫定流入 1.76 億，資金回流被宏觀壓力蓋過。
editions.headline_en: A hot CPI briefly pushed October hike odds to ~40% and $331M was liquidated in 24h, mostly longs; ETFs took in a provisional $176M on 10/13, but macro pressure drowned out the return of inflows.

editions.headline: 9 月 CPI 全面高於預期：年增 3.7%、核心月增 0.3%，10 年期殖利率跳升 9 個基點到 5.31%，BTC 應聲回落，10 月升息重回討論。
editions.headline_en: September CPI ran hot across the board: 3.7% y/y and core +0.3% m/m pushed the 10-year yield up 9bp to 5.31%, BTC slipped, and an October hike is back in play.

editions.headline: 多頭爆倉 4.06 億美元、布蘭特油價回到 106 美元，BTC 跌回價值區下方；ETF 上週淨流出 6.81 億，市場等週三 CPI。
editions.headline_en: $406M in long liquidations and Brent back at $106 push BTC below its value area; ETFs bled $681M last week as the market waits for Wednesday's CPI.

editions.headline: 川普宣布俄烏「能源停火」，BTC 週日量回升到前日 1.74 倍、資金費率年化升至 8.08%；ETF 上週流出 6.81 億後，市場等週一資金與 10/14 CPI。
現貨 BTC ETF 單週淨流出 6.81 億美元、創 6 月以來最大，週五僅回流 2,110 萬；週末縮量整理，市場等 10/14 CPI。
市場階段依規則正式轉為牛市，但 ETF 連兩日流出逾 7 億美元、美國政府搬動 1.2 萬顆沒收 BTC，資金面仍在退潮。
ETF 單日流出 4.85 億美元、油價因美伊緊張衝上 100 美元以上，BTC 盤中跌到 80,329、收 81,684（−1.91%）；離 200 日均線（71,798）仍有 13.8%，出場框架 0 條觸發。
10 年期美債殖利率盤中 5.365% 創 2002 年來新高、Fed 紀要偏鷹，BTC 收跌 2.65% 至 83,276；仍在 200 日均線（71,728）上方 13.9%，出場框架 0 條觸發。
殖利率創 2002 年來新高，BTC 跌回 83,000 附近；離任何出場點仍很遠。
